Hyannis Port Research (HPR) develops high-performance capital markets infrastructure solutions. The Platform Software Engineer I helps advance high-performance computing and electronic trading by designing, developing, and debugging C applications on multi-core Linux systems, contributing to team practices, and collaborating with customers.

Responsibilities
Utilize your expertise in low-level programming as we advance the state of the art in high performance computing and electronic trading
Provide the necessary guidance and hands-on delivery of the design, development, and debugging of C applications that run on multi-core Linux systems to process large amounts of high-throughput, low-latency network data
Be a key contributor to our process and team culture, continually iterating on *how* we build products, not just on what we build
Collaborate directly with customers that are using the products that you develop

MS/BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
0+ years of relevant DevOps, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering experience
Hands-on expertise with Kubernetes — cluster management, node provisioning, networking, and multi-environment operations
Experience with containerization technologies including Docker and Docker Compose
Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code practices and tooling
Strong scripting skills in Python and/or shell for automation and operational tooling
Experience building or maintaining internal developer tooling or simulation/testing platforms
Experience with Helm charts for packaging and deploying applications to Kubernetes
Familiarity with observability stacks — particularly Grafana and Loki for metrics, logging, and alerting
Working knowledge of object storage systems such as S3 and relational or NoSQL databases
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, preferably using GitLab
Demonstrated ability to work through complex infrastructure challenges and drive them to resolution
Experience with Node.js / Express and TypeScript in a DevOps or platform context
Familiarity with financial markets or trading systems infrastructure
Knowledge of network fundamentals relevant to Kubernetes (CNI, load balancers, ingress controllers, service meshes)
